title: F*ck it. Zero to $1,000/Day With Faceless YouTube Automation (Just Copy Me)
summary: Faceless YouTube automation pitch: pick high-RPM niches, long videos for older US viewers, chase CTR and retention, outsource to freelancers; promises $1,000 days for consistent students.

assertions.quote: I barely work just 2 hours a day on all of my channels because they run on autopilot

verdicts.note: A few channels reach that, but most never meet monetization thresholds and freelancer costs eat margins.
Most automation channels never reach monetization and freelancer costs eat margins, so thousands a month on two hours a day is rare.

assertions.quote: the make or break of longevity for your channel is targeting the older and US audience

verdicts.note: RPM varies by advertiser demand; US and older demographics and mid-roll ads on longer videos pay more.

assertions.quote: that's actually going to almost guarantee your chances of getting demonetized
if we can't get people to click, which CTR is click-through rate, then they can't convert to views

verdicts.note: YouTube's recommendation system weights click-through and watch time, per its own documentation.

assertions.quote: And there are dozens of other students who got similar results all working with me one-on-one.
look at what's currently working in the market with other channels and videos, and we need to have our own spin on it
as long as you stay consistent, you will go easily from zero to a thousand dollars a day

verdicts.note: Consistency does not guarantee views; most channels never earn meaningful ad revenue.
